product_overview: MeetOps is a centralized booking platform for organizations to manage shared resources like meeting rooms and studios. It helps users request bookings, supports approval workflows, and provides visibility into schedules and resource utilization.
core_goals: Register, log in, and recover access to an account
Browse bookings and review upcoming schedule information
Create single-day and multi-day booking requests with conflict checks
Approve, reject, or cancel bookings based on role permissions
Manage resources and user roles as an administrator
Review bookings through calendar and detailed booking views
Export booking history to PDF for visible bookings

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Create a new account with identity details, username, password, and terms acceptance.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Enter name -> Enter username -> Enter password -> Confirm the password -> Accept the terms -> Submit the registration form -> See account creation success state
Navigate to /register -> Enter a password that is too short or lacks required characters -> Attempt to submit the form -> See validation error

features.name: User Login
features.description: Sign in with username and password, with access returning to the previously requested page when applicable.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter username -> Enter password -> Submit the login form -> See the dashboard or originally requested page
Navigate to /login -> Choose the password reset option -> Navigate to /reset-password -> Request a reset link by username -> See the check-your-email confirmation state

features.name: Password Reset
features.description: Request a password reset email using a username-based recovery flow.
user_flows: Navigate to /reset-password -> Enter username -> Request the reset link -> See confirmation that the reset email was sent -> Return to the login page

features.name: Dashboard Overview
features.description: View booking summaries, upcoming bookings, quick actions, and admin-only AI insights.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Review booking statistics -> Review the upcoming bookings list -> Open a booking from the list
Navigate to /dashboard -> Choose New Booking -> Navigate to the booking creation flow
Navigate to /dashboard -> Choose View All -> Navigate to the bookings list
Navigate to /dashboard -> Choose Manage Resources as an administrator -> Navigate to resource management
Navigate to /dashboard -> Generate AI insights as an administrator -> See insights content

features.name: Bookings List and Export
features.description: Browse bookings with filters, inspect booking rows, and export booking history as PDF.
user_flows: Navigate to /bookings -> Review bookings in the list -> Filter by status or search text -> Open a booking detail view
Navigate to /bookings -> Move through past-booking pages -> Review additional bookings
Navigate to /bookings -> Open the export dialog -> Set the date range -> Export the booking history as PDF
Navigate to /bookings -> Apply a filter that matches no bookings -> See the no-bookings-found message

features.name: New Booking Wizard
features.description: Create a booking request through a three-step flow with resource selection, date and time selection, and booking details entry.
user_flows: Navigate to /bookings/new -> Select a resource -> Choose single-day booking -> Pick the date -> Set the start time -> Set the end time -> Enter the purpose -> Enter attendees -> Create the booking request

Navigate to /bookings/new -> Select a resource -> Choose multi-day booking -> Pick the date range -> Set daily start and end times -> Enter the purpose -> Enter attendees -> Create the booking request
Navigate to /bookings/new -> Select a resource -> Choose a time range that overlaps an approved booking -> See the conflict warning -> Adjust the booking time -> Continue creating the booking
Navigate to /bookings/new -> Enter an end time that is not after the start time -> Attempt to continue -> See the validation error
Navigate to /bookings/new -> Enter a multi-day range where the end date is before the start date -> Attempt to continue -> See the validation error
Navigate to /bookings/new -> Enter the purpose -> Generate an agenda with AI -> Review the generated agenda -> Edit or copy the agenda -> Continue with the booking

features.name: Booking Approval Actions
features.description: Review a booking in detail and approve, reject with a reason, or cancel it when permitted by role and status.
user_flows: Navigate to a booking detail page -> Review the full booking information -> Approve a pending booking as an authorized reviewer -> See the booking status update
Navigate to a booking detail page -> Review the full booking information -> Reject a pending booking as an authorized reviewer -> Enter a reason -> See the booking status update
Navigate to a booking detail page -> Review the full booking information -> Cancel an own booking or an authorized booking -> Confirm the cancellation -> See the booking status update
Navigate to a booking detail page -> Return to the previous page

features.name: Shared Calendar
features.description: View organization bookings in calendar form across month, week, day, and agenda views.
user_flows: Navigate to /calendar -> Switch between month, week, day, and agenda views -> Review the bookings displayed on the calendar
Navigate to /calendar -> Move to another date range -> Review bookings for the new period
Navigate to /calendar -> Open an event -> Review the booking details in the dialog -> Close the dialog

features.name: Resource Management
features.description: Administrators can create, edit, and delete shared resources such as meeting rooms.
user_flows: Navigate to /resources -> Add a resource -> Enter the name, description, location, and capacity -> Save the resource
Navigate to /resources -> Edit a resource -> Update the resource details -> Save the changes
Navigate to /resources -> Delete a resource -> Confirm deletion -> See the resource removed
Navigate to /resources -> Attempt to access the page as a non-admin -> See the no-permission message

features.name: User Management
features.description: Administrators can search users and change their roles.
user_flows: Navigate to /users -> Search for a user -> Review the matching results
Navigate to /users -> Choose to change a user's role -> Select a new role -> Update the user role -> See the updated role

features.name: Profile and Language
features.description: View account details and update the UI language preference.
user_flows: Navigate to /profile -> Review name, email, role, and member-since details -> Change the language preference -> See the updated preference

routes.description: Public marketing landing page with hero, feature cards, trust stats, and footer; adapts content if user is logged in
Combined login and register form in two-tab card with username/password validation
Standalone registration form with name/username/password validation and terms checkbox
Username-only form that sends a Supabase password-reset email
Overview with stat cards, upcoming bookings list, quick actions, and admin AI insights panel
Bookings list with active/past tables, status/user/text filters, pagination, and PDF export dialog
3-step booking wizard: resource, dates/times with conflict checking, purpose/attendees with AI agenda generation
Booking detail view with approve/reject/cancel actions and multi-day group handling
Organization-wide calendar with month/week/day/agenda views, status-colored events, and realtime updates
Admin-only resource (meeting room) CRUD with add/edit dialog and delete with active-booking guard
Admin-only user management table with search and change-role dialog
Read-only account info card with role badge and language preference selector

known_limitations.issue: Broken translations on BookingDetailPage - t() wrapper missing so raw i18n keys like "bookingDetails.resource" render as literal text
known_limitations.impact: Booking detail page shows raw translation keys instead of human-readable labels

known_limitations.issue: Landing page footer links (About/Contact/Help/Privacy/Terms) are dead href="#" anchors
Conflict detection is client-side only; race window exists between check and insert with no server-side constraint
known_limitations.impact: Two simultaneous bookings could double-book a resource

known_limitations.issue: PDF export dialog defines resource/status filter state but the filter controls are never rendered (unimplemented)
known_limitations.impact: Only date-range filtering works in PDF export despite planned filters

known_limitations.issue: Registration UI duplicated between LoginPage register tab and RegisterPage with hand-rolled state instead of shared form logic
known_limitations.impact: Validation logic is duplicated and can drift

known_limitations.issue: Role gating is client-side only (in-page profile.role checks); RouteGuard does not enforce roles and RLS is not verifiable from frontend
known_limitations.impact: Admin restrictions depend on backend RLS being correctly configured

known_limitations.issue: Auth maps usernames to synthetic emails ({username}@miaoda.com); password reset emails may go to an address the user does not own
known_limitations.impact: Password reset flow may be untestable with real users

known_limitations.issue: Supabase client has placeholder URL/key fallbacks; app silently uses a dead client if env vars missing
known_limitations.impact: App appears to work but all data operations fail when env vars are absent

known_limitations.issue: Active bookings table has no pagination and filters are client-side on fully fetched rows
known_limitations.impact: Performance degrades as booking count grows
